faq.title: Help Desk
faq.subtitle: Questions, beautifully answered.
faq.q1: How long does shipping take within Bangladesh?
faq.a1: We deliver within 1-2 business days inside Dhaka and 3-5 business days for the rest of Bangladesh. All orders are processed within 24 hours.
faq.q2: Do you offer Cash on Delivery (COD)?
faq.a2: Yes! We offer Cash on Delivery (COD) across all 64 districts of Bangladesh. You can also pay via bKash, Nagad, or card payment during checkout.
faq.q3: What is your return & exchange policy?
faq.a3: We accept returns and exchanges within 3 days of delivery. Products must be unused and in their original packaging. Contact our support team to initiate a return.
faq.q4: Can I track my order status publicly?
faq.a4: Yes, you can track your order using the tracking ID sent to your email or phone. Visit our 'Track Order' page for real-time updates.
faq.q5: Do you have a physical retail flagship store?
faq.a5: Yes! We have a flagship store in Gulshan, Dhaka. Visit us for a premium in-person shopping experience with personal styling consultations.
